note.ja: 既存のEwald/SPME、2D対数FMM、cold PIC、等質衝突と純吸収平板を保持し、別配布の中性スラブ、3D1/r FMM、限定した重力軌道、熱的PIC、剛体球DSMCの壁面・衝撃波も案内します。追加の放射例は等方散乱、非平衡拡散・輸送、静止M1と角度法の2D比較です。条件・独立参照・収束・有限seedを各例で区別し、原Lagrange PME、一般の分野間連成、固定格子APや放射流体まで実装したとはしません。
note.en: Preserve Ewald/SPME, 2D logarithmic FMM, cold PIC, homogeneous collisions and pure-absorption slabs, with separate companions for neutral slabs, 3D 1/r FMM, scoped gravity trajectories, warm PIC and hard-sphere DSMC walls/shocks. Added radiation examples cover isotropic scattering, non-equilibrium diffusion/transport and 2D static-M1/angular comparisons. Each example states conditions, reference independence, refinement and finite-seed scope; original Lagrange PME, general cross-field coupling, fixed-grid AP and radiation hydrodynamics remain outside these implementations.
